declaration.hidden_update_rule: Each cell carries a refractory/age state cycling through dead-ready, alive, and dead-refractory, with the hidden state advancing deterministically based on whether the cell just fired.
declaration.mechanism: A dead-ready cell becomes alive when it has exactly two visible live neighbors; a live cell always turns off next step; a dead-refractory cell also turns off but recovers to dead-ready after one step. Equivalently this is the 3-state excitable Greenberg-Hastings-style rule B2/S/ on a torus, so the visible frame alone is insufficient because two visually dead cells can differ by whether they are ready to be born.
